brands.evidence: Monzo remains one of the most popular digital banks in the UK, it attracts a specific set of regular complaints.

client_claims.text: Monzo has scaled to over 9 million users
client_claims.note: 15.2m customers and 10.4m monthly active; 'over 9 million' is a lower bound that contains the figures, so not contradicted.

client_claims.text: Free foreign ATM withdrawals are capped at typically £200/month fee-free outside the EEA on standard accounts, followed by a 3% charge
Monzo's paid plans are Extra, Perks and Max
Monzo charges £1 per deposit at PayPoint, with a maximum of £300 in one go and up to £1,000 every 180 days
client_claims.note: No fact covers cash deposit fees or limits.

client_claims.text: Larger cheques (over £500) must be posted to Monzo by Royal Mail
Monzo offers Joint Accounts, and both parties must already have individual Monzo accounts to open one
Monzo Flex is Monzo's buy-now-pay-later credit product, and the app promotes loans and overdrafts
Features like virtual cards, advanced budgeting, custom categories and credit score tracking were bundled into paid plans
